about_the_game:
This add-on will be coming soon.

Please wait a little longer until its release.

Polka oru ka? Oru yo! (In Treasure Mountain!)

The one and only eccentric hololive talent, Omaru Polka,
is finally joining hololive Treasure Mountain as a commentator!
With her unpredictable ad-libs and boundless energy,
Treasure Mountain transforms into a full-blown Polka World!?

About Omaru Polka’s “POPOPOPO DLC”

This DLC lets you choose “Omaru Polka” as a new commentator!
Once selected, Polka herself will pop onto the screen during gameplay,

bringing her signature circus-style commentary to life,
all set to the rhythm of a HOLOGRAM CIRCUS remix!

A must-see for all Polka fans! A brand-new opening included!

Why has Omaru Polka landed on Captain Marine’s island?
The answer may be a long story… or maybe not?
Either way, don’t miss the exclusive Polka-themed opening!

Get ready for an even more exciting adventure!
Enjoy this all-out Polka-packed DLC to your heart’s content!

※You can change the commentary character from the title by selecting:

　"Marine's Treasures" > "Select Commentator".
